title: The completed integral uniformizer section
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, its valuation ring $\mathcal O_E$ and the chosen uniformizer $\varpi_E$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $T$ be a scheme. On its small pro-etale site use the completed coefficient sheaf $R=\widehat{\mathcal O}_{E,T}=\varprojlim_{n\geq1}(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n)_T$ and the canonical map from the constant integral coefficient sheaf to $R$ [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients]. Define the completed uniformizer section $\pi_T\in\Gamma(T_{\mathrm{proet}},R)$ to be the image of the constant section $\varpi_E$ under this map. Explicitly, on every site object $U$ its value is the image of $\varpi_E$ under constant sheafification followed by the constant-to-completion map; equivalently its projection to each $(\mathcal O_E/\varpi_E^n)_T$ is the constant residue class of $\varpi_E$.
